Hi Emily / Samir —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. We’re excited to get the activation blueprint (the MAP + eval plan) kicked off so we can align on success criteria and timelines toward your Q3 pilot close.

Proposed next steps:
- 30–45 minute kickoff to introduce stakeholders, confirm roles, and review the evaluation plan and acceptance criteria
- Ops check: confirm Zoom, calendar invites, and any SSO or firewall needs
- Share a short agenda and vendor Qs in advance so your team can prepare

Availability: Rafael and Ben are free Tues/Wed next week in the 10–12 PT window; Laura can join either day but prefers morning PT. Can you share 2 windows that work for your team?

I’ve attached a draft agenda (activation_blueprint_agenda_v1.pdf) and a short vendor questions spreadsheet (vendor_questions_nbh.xlsx) for Northbridge to scan — high-level items: data flow, security controls (audit logs, key management), and evaluation metrics.

Zoom: I’ll include a working link in the calendar invite once we lock time.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
